name: com.iplover/iplover
title: iplover
description: IP owner, network type, blocklists, domain health, DNS and crawler checks from public sources.

tools.name: lookup_ip
tools.description: Who is behind an IPv4 or IPv6 address: owner and network from the regional registry (RDAP), the ASN, the registry country (not a geolocation), the network type (ISP, mobile, hosting, VPN, Tor, a company's own network) with its confidence and evidence, reverse DNS with a forward-confirmation check (FCrDNS), and matches in public blocklists with their dates. Includes a plain-language verdict and links (only links) to third-party services such as VirusTotal and AbuseIPDB. The full report is at report_url (/ip/<address> on iplover.com).

language.description: Language of the human-readable fields (verdict, explanation, labels).

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: A domain report from public data: registrar and expiry (RDAP), hosting and IPv6, email security (MX, SPF, DKIM on common selectors, DMARC, MTA-STS), DNS (name servers, CAA, DNSSEC), the website (HTTP status, HTTPS redirect, security headers) and the TLS certificate (judged from the HTTPS connection; the Certificate Transparency record with issuer and expiry date is in certificate.data.ct when cached, otherwise at certificate.data.ct_url). Each check has a status (good, info, warn, bad, na) and a plain-language explanation; the counts summarize them. Checked once, from one location. The full report is at report_url (/report?domain=<domain> on iplover.com).

domain.description: A domain name, e.g. example.com (no scheme or path).

language.description: Language of the human-readable fields (verdict, explanation, labels).

tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.description: DNS records of a domain over DNS-over-HTTPS (Cloudflare, with Google Public DNS as fallback): A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA, CAA, or all of them. Returns each record with its TTL, the resolver used, the DMARC record and DNSSEC status. The full report is at report_url (/dns?name=<name> on iplover.com).

language.description: Language of the human-readable fields (verdict, explanation, labels).

tools.name: verify_bot
tools.description: Is a request really from the crawler it claims to be (Googlebot, Bingbot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot...)? Give the address, the user agent, or both. The address is checked against the operator's published IP lists and, where the operator supports it, forward-confirmed reverse DNS under the operator's domain. Verdicts: verified, spoofed (claims a bot that publishes its addresses, but isn't from them), different (another known bot), unverified (the bot publishes nothing to check against), notbot, claim (user agent only: what it claims, never proof). The full report is at report_url (/verify-bot?ip=<ip>&ua=<user agent> on iplover.com).

ip.description: The request's IPv4 or IPv6 address.

language.description: Language of the human-readable fields (verdict, explanation, labels).

tools.name: check_my_ip
tools.description: The public IP address this MCP request came from, with Cloudflare's approximate location and network for it. For a remote agent this is usually the agent platform's address, not the end user's device. The full report is at report_url (/ip/<address> on iplover.com).

language.description: Language of the human-readable fields (verdict, explanation, labels).
